_comment: Baseline CPU instruction counts for gas regression detection. Values sourced from benchmarks/gas-optimization-report.md (2026-04-23). CI fails if measured instructions exceed baseline * 1.10 (10% tolerance).

withdraw_all_50_streams._note: Measured via test_withdraw_all_50_streams_within_budget (TEST-27 / issue #250). 50 active streams, 100s elapsed, rate=10/s. Soroban testutils default budget enforced. CI regresses if >10% above this baseline (~81_796_000).
